facts.fact: 父亲指着两个女孩夸她们完美：整洁、有礼、温柔、玩公主与茶会、不骂人不打架；又说“Proper little girls”——像他和母亲一直希望有的那种。
facts.anchor: “Look at them.” He gestured. “Aren’t they perfect? They’re tidy and neat.

facts.fact: 父亲说孩子没法挑，但多年期盼、九个月等待后拿到“plain, sulky, lazy, careless”的孩子，难免失望。
facts.anchor: “We understood you don’t get to choose,” he said. “You get the kid you’re dealt and you do your best with what you’re given.

facts.fact: 父亲把两个女孩并排摆在崖边、背对风，说“Pose just there, girls”，要拍张照让 Tammy“明白点事”。
facts.anchor: He placed the two girls, standing side by side, backs to the wind at the edge of the cliff.

facts.fact: 关键施事：是**父亲**一把把**姐姐 Lucy**推下悬崖；小身体撞在下面岩石上的碎裂声让她跪地呕吐。
facts.anchor: With a quick, sharp shove, he pushed Lucy off the cliff.

facts.fact: 父亲又把**较小的 Laura-Ann**推下崖；她哭喊“What the fuck?!”，父亲说“This is what you wanted. This is what you’ve always wanted.”
facts.anchor: Then he shoved Laura-Ann off the cliff.

facts.fact: 父亲把斧刃悬在自己指节上、低声说“这屋里只有一个怪物，就是你”；她因“This house”醒悟“We’re still inside the house”，在斧头落下前抓住斧柄。
facts.anchor: “There’s only one monster in this house, Tammy. And it’s you.”

facts.fact: 她反驳：我不是恶毒，我是愤怒——一直嫉妒、苦涩，以为愤怒能保护自己，其实只是累；“it’s not all about me”。
facts.anchor: “I’m not spiteful, I’m angry,” I said between sniffs. “I’m so angry. All the time.

facts.fact: 她收线打结，父亲的身影连同悬崖、海、风筝一起坠入虚无，只剩她和地下室；她说“Bye, Dad.”
